source: Pew Research Center. 2016. "One-in-Five U.S. Adults Were Raised in Interfaith Homes."
method: Population is current religious tradition (reltrad). qc9 asks whether, since turning 18, there has ever been a time the respondent attended religious services LESS often than they do now; this reads the "yes" share, i.e. the share whose attendance has ever lapsed. Don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (this recontact reached only 5,000 of the main 2014 RLS's 35,071 respondents). Weighted by the dataset's own `rweight` variable.
